page.overview:
Who is Peter Gethin?

Peter Kenneth Gethin (February 21, 1940 - December 5, 2011) was a British racing driver, who competed in Formula One between 1970-1974 and won the 1971 Italian Grand Prix. Gethin is also notable for being the only man to win any race in a Formula 5000 car, having won the (non-championship) 1973 Race of Champions in a Chevron-Chevrolet.

Peter Gethin made his Formula One début for at the Dutch Grand Prix, replacing the team's founder Bruce McLaren. His teammate would be Denny Hulme.

Gethin remained with McLaren for another season, and this time the team was reduced to only 2 cars. He won in the Italian Grand Prix with a close margin between him, Ronnie Peterson, François Cevert, Mike Hailwood and Howden Ganley.

Gethin moved to for 1972. He only scored points at Italy, finishing 6th.
